meta.title: perf: Remove preemptive deepcopy operations from exported methods
meta.body_summary: Remove preemptive deepcopy calls in ExtendedDataSquare exported methods, returning direct references to internal data and providing an exported DeepCopy utility for callers who need mutable copies; claims dramatic speedup.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot removed deepcopies with benchmark claims; maintainer iterated on export and simplification but PR stalled as draft and was closed without merge.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 469 changed lines, this is a small-to-medium edit by absolute volume, concentrated in Go source and test files. As a targeted performance PR it was closed after iterative review, not merged, consistent with a stalled process rather than scale rejection.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer adlerjohn noted that deepCopy was unexported, preventing library users from copying returned data; Copilot renamed to DeepCopy. Later, adlerjohn flagged that internal row/col methods became redundant after pass-through refactor, triggering further simplification.
review_details.performance_claim: Row access ~6,000x faster (0.8 ns vs 4,841 ns); RowRoots access ~420x faster (2.8 ns vs 1,179 ns) by avoiding deepcopy overhead.
review_details.rejection_signals: PR converted to draft after iterative review; no merge approval or final rejection comment; later closed without merge.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Agent produced working optimization with benchmark, but maintainer's iterative requests (export helper, README example, redundant method cleanup) led to a draft state and eventual closure without explicit acceptance or rejection—suggesting the PR’s life cycle was derailed by process churn.

detection_detail.code_reading: adlerjohn manually inspected extendeddatasquare.go, identified the unexported deepCopy, later suggested removal of redundant internal methods; copilot bot provided test assertion fixes.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body cites concrete benchmark numbers but provides no benchmark code or reproduction steps.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Copilot implemented requested changes (exported DeepCopy, updated README, removed redundant methods) within the same PR; no external revert required.

core_change_summary.description: In extendeddatasquare.go, removed deepcopy calls from Row, Col, RowRoots, ColRoots, Flattened methods and added documentation about direct references; exported the helper as DeepCopy; removed redundant internal row/col methods; updated tests to validate direct references and proper copying.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: A temporary performance_test.go was added then removed; README example added; internal method removal impacted multiple files.
